sculpt_seat_stone.notes: The sitting stone at the road shrine (gameplay/errands-props.js makeSeat): facet-kit stone with a worn flat seat at 0.44 m, bevelled edges, lichen bloom, moss along the back. Origin under the sitter's hips; neutral stone (the game tints it). LOD tris 305 / 158 / 36. Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, written once).
